label: Ridgeline Native Full Audit
changes: overlay download watchdog: a topographic tile download outstanding 20 s or more is released and retried (checked every 5 s while downloads are outstanding), so a request whose result never arrives can no longer hold one of the four overlay slots while its tile stays in view

diagnostics: overlay tiles prepared and in view, downloads in flight, oldest download age, stale releases and refusals; line packets sent, accepted, rejected and re-sent; groups held by the renderer; whether names are applied
rootCause: not confirmed on a device: toggling overlays or moving away (both release overlay download slots) restores overlays, which points at downloads that never complete; the new diagnostics will show it
